title: Hsp70 and Hsp60 Chaperone Mechanisms: Orchestrating Proteostasis in Health and Disease
description: This article provides a comprehensive analysis of the structural and functional mechanisms of Hsp70 and Hsp60 molecular chaperones in maintaining cellular proteostasis. It explores their ATP-dependent allosteric regulation, cooperation with co-chaperones, and dysregulation in human pathologies like cancer and neurodegenerative diseases. The review also covers advanced research methodologies and emerging therapeutic strategies that target these chaperone networks.
